description: This Java interface defines a client connection to an AMQP-based Hono service, providing methods to establish, manage, and create links and perform interactions with the server. It includes connection lifecycle management, link creation for sending and receiving messages, and support for extended behaviors such as re-connection, shutdown, and context execution.

classes.name: HonoConnection
classes.description: An interface representing a client AMQP connection to a Hono service, with methods to connect, disconnect, create message links, and manage connection lifecycle.

methods.name: newConnection
methods.description: Creates a new HonoConnection instance with the specified Vertx instance and client configuration properties.

methods.name: getVertx
methods.description: Returns the Vertx instance used by this connection.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Returns the OpenTracing tracer used for distributed tracing.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the client configuration properties used for this connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the AMQP connection using default options, returning a Future that completes upon connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the AMQP connection with custom ProtonClientOptions, returning a Future.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the client from the server without shutting down the connection object.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully closes the connection, waiting up to 5 seconds.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes the connection asynchronously, invoking the provided handler upon completion.

methods.name: isShutdown
methods.description: Indicates if the connection is already shut down or in the process.

methods.name: getRemoteContainer
methods.description: Returns the remote container ID as advertised by the peer, defaulting to "N/A".

methods.name: supportsCapability
methods.description: Checks if the client supports a specific AMQP capability, reliable only if connected.

methods.name: executeOrRunOnContext
methods.description: Executes a given code block on the vert.x context associated with the connection.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an AMQP sender link to a target address with specified QoS and optional close hook.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver link with given address, QoS, message handler, and optional close hook.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver link with specified address, QoS, message handler, prefetch size, and auto-accept setting.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver with all parameters, including auto-accept behavior.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes a link and releases resources, using a default timeout.

methods.name: closeAndFree
methods.description: Closes a link with a specified timeout, and invokes the provided handler after closure.
